Q5803.reason: Drug users aren't a suspect or quasi-suspect class, so the regulation gets rational basis review and only needs to relate to a legitimate state interest.

Q5805.reason: A joint tenant's conveyance of their interest severs the joint tenancy as to that share, so the grantee holds a one-third interest as a tenant in common and can devise it.

Q5807.reason: Deadly force, including firing a gun, is not privileged to protect property or stop a fleeing thief of a rake, so the force was unreasonable.
